AUD crushed after Fed fails 'Warshach test'; rate hike expectations build pressure on Australian equities
IMF urges Australian government to cut spending ahead of another RBA rate hike
WA exploration pipeline strong: Dalaroo copper-nickel-PGE, Critica rare earths, Augustus gold targets
Anthropic secures $31bn datacentre deal in western Queensland, boosting tech/infrastructure narrative
Housing affordability crisis deepens; ACCC moves against real estate monopoly; tenants see modest relief
Qantas ground staff strike looms over 'Joyce-era' bargaining; fuel supply crunch at east-coast ports
Bathla collapse triggers insolvency storm; Cue and Veronika Maine fashion brands face collapse
Middle East oil shock risk elevated; coal policy debate intensifies under Albanese government

sectors.trend: Positive exploration momentum in WA: Dalaroo copper-nickel-PGE survey, Critica 58% rare earths carbonate, Augustus 30g/t gold target. Oil price slide pressures energy miners but supports base metals demand.
sectors.implications: Exploration names (CRX.AX, AUG.AX) see near-term catalysts; BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX supported by China-as-safe-haven narrative but face oil-driven energy headwinds. Rare earths theme gaining policy tailwind.

sectors.trend: Big four banks advance on easing bond yields and Wall Street rally. However, state governments face soaring interest costs, Bathla insolvency creates credit overhang, and IMF spending-cut pressure may constrain fiscal support.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX benefit from yield compression but face NPL risk from insolvency wave. Rate hike expectations could compress net interest margins.

sectors.trend: Oil prices sliding on Middle East de-escalation hopes but 'oil shock' risk remains. Coal policy debate (Albo government) and green hydrogen waste allegations create policy uncertainty. Fuel supply crunch at east-coast ports.
sectors.implications: WDS.AX, WLE.AX face margin pressure from oil slide; coal names (BHP.AX coal division) face policy risk. Fuel distributors (WES.AX supply chain) see cost inflation.

sectors.trend: Coles maintains elevated milk prices post-farmer support removal; Qantas strike threat; fashion brands Cue/Veronika Maine near collapse. Real wage growth crushed by exploited workers.
sectors.implications: WES.AX, CBA.AX (consumer lending) face margin pressure. QAN.AX strike risk is a near-term catalyst. Consumer discretionary under pressure from wage stagnation.

sectors.trend: Anthropic $31bn QLD datacentre deal signals major AI infrastructure buildout. AI investment accelerating globally (Comfort Systems, ARK portfolios). Domestic tech talent exodus to US ($2.1b Meta salary).
sectors.implications: Infrastructure and datacentre REITs (VAP.AX, GPT.AX) benefit. CSL.AX and biotech (INSM, RVMD) see global clinical trial tailwinds. Local tech talent drain is a structural concern.

sectors.trend: Housing 'absurdly unaffordable'; ACCC targets real estate monopoly; tenants see modest rent relief. Trump policy mulls crashing Aussie house prices via trade/immigration levers.
sectors.implications: REITs (GPW.AX, DGL.AX) face mixed signals: tenant relief caps upside but ACCC action may boost occupancy. Construction (WBC.AX exposure) pressured by affordability ceiling.

key_themes: Fed rate hike expectations crushing AUD and pressuring ASX via capital outflows
IMF fiscal austerity signal constraining Australian government spending capacity
WA exploration super-cycle: copper, rare earths, gold all showing strong results
Housing affordability crisis reaching policy tipping point with ACCC intervention
AI infrastructure buildout ($31bn Anthropic) as structural growth theme
Insolvency contagion risk (Bathla, fashion brands) testing financial sector resilience
Middle East oil shock as tail risk to energy and inflation

risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge AUD exposure; favour domestic-revenue ASX names; monitor RBA response
Overweight energy producers (WDS.AX, WLE.AX) as hedge; monitor Brent/WTI
Reduce REIT and construction exposure; monitor NAB/CBA loan growth
Screen supply-chain exposure; avoid small-cap consumer discretionary
Avoid QAN.AX near-term; monitor travel/airline-linked REITs

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight WA exploration and rare earths names
opportunities.rationale: Dalaroo, Critica, Augustus results signal multi-year WA resource upcycle; policy support for critical minerals
$31bn Anthropic QLD deal and global AI capex acceleration support long-term demand

opportunities.recommendation: Tactical long big four banks on yield easing
opportunities.rationale: Bond yield compression supports NIM; Wall Street rally provides sentiment tailwind

defensive_moves.rationale: Fed hike risk and oil slide create dual headwind for exporters and energy consumers
Affordability crisis, ACCC intervention, and Trump policy risk cap upside

defensive_moves.recommendation: Avoid QAN.AX and small-cap consumer discretionary
defensive_moves.rationale: Strike risk and insolvency contagion create asymmetric downside

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to grind higher on Wall Street spillover and bank strength, but AUD weakness and Fed hike risk cap gains. Oil slide supports consumer staples but pressures energy. Qantas strike and insolvency headlines create volatility. Net: modest upside, 1–2% range-bound.
market_outlook.long_term: Structural tailwinds from WA resource cycle, AI infrastructure buildout, and critical minerals policy support 6–12 month ASX upside. However, IMF fiscal tightening, housing correction risk, and global trade fragmentation (Trump policy) create headwinds. Expect choppy but gradually higher path if RBA holds.

Australian CPI and wage growth data
